claims.text: Your original products summed to 2. Rotating only the input changed the sum to 1; rotating the kernel as well restored 2. This is a concrete counterexample to guaranteed rotation invariance for this fixed cross-correlation. There is one valid output, with no padding or stride ambiguity. It does not establish that no convolutional network can learn rotation robustness.
